# Rayline

> Rayline connects coding agents and applications to models. ARC chooses the model and reasoning effort for every request; Raydock connects tools on your device to local models and cloud services. Rayline Platform is the hosted service at platform.rayline.ai. ARC Dynamic exposes routing value and temperature. ARC is in beta: fields marked `x-status: proposed` in the OpenAPI may change before launch.

## Start here

- [Use Rayline in your tools](https://docs.rayline.ai/tools): connect OpenCode, Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex, pi and oh-my-pi.
- [ARC Swift and ARC Sage](https://docs.rayline.ai/arc/models): model IDs `arc-swift-1.0`, `arc-sage-1.0`, and ARC Dynamic `arc-1.0`.
- [API quickstart](https://docs.rayline.ai/arc/quickstart): a first Messages request and a first route.

## API reference

- [OpenAPI (machine-readable)](https://docs.rayline.ai/api-reference/arc-public-api.openapi.yaml): service-owned contract for ARC model IDs, the `routing` extension, the Routes API (`POST /v1/routes`) and error codes.
- [Generation API reference](https://docs.rayline.ai/arc/reference/generation): Messages, Chat Completions, Responses; `routing.value_usd` and `routing.temperature`.
- [Routes API reference](https://docs.rayline.ai/arc/reference/routes): `routing.{value_usd, temperature, models, excluded_models, prices, price_profile}`, `presets.{swift,sage}`, `custom`, the `routing` echo, `error.code`.
- [API compatibility](https://docs.rayline.ai/arc/reference/compatibility) and [errors and limits](https://docs.rayline.ai/arc/reference/errors).

## Guides

- [Routes API](https://docs.rayline.ai/arc/routes), [bring your own prices](https://docs.rayline.ai/arc/routes/prices), [applying effort](https://docs.rayline.ai/arc/routes/applying-effort), [build an agent with Claude Code](https://docs.rayline.ai/arc/routes/claude-code-agent).
- [ARC Dynamic](https://docs.rayline.ai/arc/dynamic): set routing value and temperature.
- [Funding and billing](https://docs.rayline.ai/platform/billing), [API keys](https://docs.rayline.ai/platform/api-keys), [data and privacy](https://docs.rayline.ai/platform/data-privacy).

## Limits for agents

- Authenticate with a Rayline API key (`rlk-...`) from the environment, in `x-api-key` or `Authorization: Bearer`. Never write a key into code or config.
- The base URL is `https://api.rayline.ai`. Do not append `/v1` for Claude Code; OpenAI-style clients use `/v1`.
- A route executes nothing: run the chosen model yourself. Treat `routing` members echoed `unsupported` as not applied.

## Legacy

- [Rules Router](https://docs.rayline.ai/legacy/rules-router): existing saved routing policies, available under Settings → Legacy.
